description: Test file for the 'model' package in Mattermost, focusing on license features, license validity, and license type checks.

methods.name: TestLicenseFeaturesToMap
methods.description: Tests the conversion of Features to a map and verifies default feature flags.

methods.name: TestLicenseFeaturesSetDefaults
methods.description: Tests setting default feature flags and their values after modification.

methods.name: TestLicenseIsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the license expiration logic correctly identifies expired licenses.

methods.name: TestLicenseIsPastGracePeriod
methods.description: Verifies if licenses past the grace period are correctly identified.

methods.name: TestLicenseIsStarted
methods.description: Checks if license start date logic correctly determines if a license has started.

methods.name: TestIsCloud
methods.description: Determines if a license is recognized as a cloud license based on features.

methods.name: TestLicenseRecordIsValid
methods.description: Validates the correctness of license record validation logic.

methods.name: TestLicenseRecordPreSave
methods.description: Ensures that pre-save logic correctly sets creation timestamp.

methods.name: TestIsLegacyTrialRequest
methods.description: Checks if a trial license request is identified as legacy based on its fields.

methods.name: TestTrialLicenseRequestIsValid
methods.description: Validates the logic for determining if a trial license request is valid.

methods.name: TestLicense_IsTrialLicense
methods.description: Tests detection of trial licenses via flag and duration.

methods.name: TestLicense_IsSanctionedTrial
methods.description: Checks if a license is recognized as a sanctioned trial based on duration.

methods.name: TestLicenseHasSharedChannels
methods.description: Verifies shared channels feature based on license features and SKU.

methods.name: TestMinimumProfessionalLicense
methods.description: Determines if a license meets minimum requirements for a professional license.

methods.name: TestMinimumEnterpriseLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license qualifies as at least an enterprise license.

methods.name: TestMinimumEnterpriseAdvancedLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license qualifies as an enterprise advanced license.
